headline: Two o'clock thins the air.
body: The second hour arrives without announcement, only a radiator ticking itself smaller. Ink on the blotter has dried to a darker brown. Across the glass, a single window still burns three floors down.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: low cloud, no moon to argue with

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: amber ring, rim beginning to fade
